import idaapi, ida_funcs, idc, ida_search
from collections import defaultdict
ids = [1000,1001,1002,1007,1005,1006,1009]
hits = defaultdict(set)
for imm in ids:
    ea = 0
    n = 0
    while n < 5000:
        r = ida_search.find_imm(ea, ida_search.SEARCH_DOWN, imm)
        # IDA 9 may return (ea, opnum) or ea
        if isinstance(r, tuple):
            ea2 = r[0]
        else:
            ea2 = r
        if ea2 == idaapi.BADADDR or ea2 is None:
            break
        f = ida_funcs.get_func(int(ea2))
        if f:
            hits[int(f.start_ea)].add(imm)
        ea = int(ea2) + 1
        n += 1
ranked = sorted(((len(v), k, sorted(v)) for k,v in hits.items()), reverse=True)
out = []
for score, addr, found in ranked[:60]:
    if score >= 3:
        name = idc.get_func_name(addr)
        size = ida_funcs.get_func(addr).size()
        out.append("%d %s %s size=%s ids=%s" % (score, hex(addr), name, hex(size), found))
print("COUNT_FUNCS", len(out))
print("\n".join(out[:50]))
